en.headline: Hang Seng extends losing streak into a fifth session
en.dek: The benchmark was down about 319 points, or 1.3 percent, in late morning trade, with technology and property shares leading the retreat.
body: Hong Kong stocks fell for a fifth straight session on Friday, with the Hang Seng Index last at 24,635.75 around 10.34am, down 318.72 points or 1.28 percent. The index opened 236 points lower at 24,718 and later traded as low as about 24,570. The Hang Seng Tech Index was down about 1.5 percent and the properties sub-index more than 3 percent.

Heavyweight technology names tracked a cautious mood. Tencent Holdings and Alibaba Group were each more than 1 percent lower in early dealings, while energy counters such as CNOOC rose with firmer crude prices. Sun Hung Kai Properties, which reported annual results on Thursday, was among the weaker blue chips after those figures.

Thursday’s close was 24,954.47, down 320 points or 1.27 percent, taking the index back below 25,000 for the first time in more than six weeks. Brokers pointed to higher oil prices, firmer US rate expectations and thin turnover. Friday morning turnover was still building after an open of about HK$3.2 billion.

zh.headline: 恒指連跌第五日 午前跌約319點
zh.dek: 恒生指數周五上午10時34分報24,635點，跌318點或1.28%，科技股及地產分類指數較弱。
body: 港股周五連續第五個交易日下跌。恒生指數上午10時34分報24,635.75點，跌318.72點或1.28%。指數低開236點於24,718點，其後低見過24,570點水平。恒生科技指數跌約1.5%，地產分類指數跌逾3%。
重磅科技股偏軟，騰訊及阿里巴巴早段各跌逾1%；能源股則受油價支持，中海油等造好。新鴻基地產周四公布全年業績後，周五股價繼續偏軟，成為拖累藍籌之一。
恒指周四收市報24,954.47點，跌320點或1.27%，時隔一個半月再失守25,000點。經紀指油價高企、市場對美國息口預期升溫，加上成交淡靜，令氛圍受壓。周五開市成交約32億元，其後逐步增加。
